recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1970s-inspired graphic featuring interlocking, heavy-stroked gradient typography integrated with a tropical palm tree and sun motif, set against a radial sunburst background with a classic pin-up figure in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography interlocking with illustrative elements like the palm tree trunk.
Radial sunburst lines emanating from the central logo focal point.
Pin-up figure providing a human element and scale at the bottom right.
Consistent thick black and white outlines unifying disparate graphic elements.
coreInvariants: Heavy multi-layered outlines on primary text.
Vertical blue-to-green gradients within the lettering.
Integration of a circular sun and palm tree into the letterforms.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central interlocking logo dominates the upper two-thirds; smaller pin-up figure sits at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large circular sun and palm tree cluster on the right side of the main text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left of the large text, follows the curve down to the secondary text, and ends on the pin-up figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean white background outside the radial sunburst area.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan and Royal Blue gradients for the primary text body.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Green at the top of the text and in the palm fronds.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Yellow and Orange for the sun and the pin-up's accessories.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with strong value contrast provided by thick black outlines.
paletteRestrictions: Pure white and black for outlines

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with extremely tight, overlapping kerning.
Multi-layered outlines: thin black inner, thick white middle, thin black outer.
Integrated illustrative elements replacing or wrapping around glyphs.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders on 'p', 'b', and 'l' are exaggeratedly tall.
The 'e' features a horizontal bar that extends to underline the preceding letters.
The 'i' is replaced or merged with the palm tree trunk.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact custom display lettering paired with a grounded, readable slab-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the circular skeleton needed for the interlocking 'p', 'a', 'b' forms.
Matches the slab-serif aesthetic of the subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a clean white background with a fine-line radial sunburst in light blue. Place a vibrant 1950s-style pin-up woman sitting in the bottom right corner, wearing a blue striped top and black shorts. Include a stylized palm tree and a yellow-orange sun circle in the upper right quadrant.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom interlocking lowercase lettering in a geometric style. Apply a vertical gradient from green at the top to blue at the bottom. Use a triple outline (black-white-black). Position the text so it interlocks with the palm tree trunk. Add a secondary line of text below in a black slab-serif font.

verificationChecks: Check that the text has a triple-layered outline.
Ensure the gradient flows vertically from green to blue.
Verify the radial sunburst lines are thin and centered behind the logo.
Confirm the pin-up figure is in a classic seated pose.

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the white outline layer
mustRedesign: Specific brand names or band logos
Exact likeness of the pin-up figure

avoid: Overly complex or illegible letter overlaps

postGenerationChecks: Is the text legible despite the interlocking?
Does the palm tree feel integrated into the logo rather than just placed next to it?
Is the 70s tropical vibe consistent across all elements?
Are the outlines crisp and uniform?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Geometric Interlocking Typography] + [Tropical Iconography] + [Retro Pin-up Illustration] + [Radial Sunburst Background] using a [Blue-Green Gradient] and [Triple-Stroke Outlines].
